checkpoints.description: [1/5] Plan: add interstellar nebula backdrop, Rayleigh limb scattering, navigational bearing compass reticle, and combat flak/arc particles.

impact_assessment.why: Elevate cosmic visual grandeur, spatial navigation orientation, atmospheric fidelity, and combat kinetic immersion in Voidfarer cockpit.
impact_assessment.benefits: Multi-layered procedural cosmic dust nebulae, atmospheric limb glow, holographic bearing compass, tactical combat flak/arc FX, and categorized flight log telemetry chips.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preserve 60fps canvas performance and clean GameState serialization; dependency: zero external dependencies; concurrency: thread-safe engine; state: clean state cloning.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Deterministic seeded procedural rendering, canvas layer caching, 12px text floor preservation, 100% test pass gate, and Playwright screenshot verification.

handoff.next: implement nebula dust lanes and atmospheric scattering in celestial.js

[1/3] Plan: implement multi-layer starfield parallax during radar pan, drag inertia, smooth camera focus interpolation, and off-screen target navigation chevrons.

impact_assessment.why: Panning the radar canvas currently leaves the cosmic backdrop static and abruptly stops with zero drag inertia, lacking spatial depth and off-screen situational awareness.
impact_assessment.benefits: Adds rich cosmic parallax depth during navigation, smooth physics-based pan inertia, animated camera centering, and off-screen target navigation reticles.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preserve 60fps canvas performance and clean GameState serialization; dependency: zero external dependencies; concurrency: thread-safe engine; state: clean state cloning.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Offscreen canvas backdrop layer caching, requestAnimationFrame timestamp delta interpolation, single-declaration palette compliance, and 100% test pass gate.

checkpoints.description: [2/2] Verify: drag momentum, starfield parallax, smooth camera focus, range scale and offscreen chevrons verified; 1,111 tests pass; 5/5 gates pass. checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-radar-pan-parallax-and-camera-focus' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: implement orbital station visual architecture, pneumatic docking/warp/flak audio synthesis, and character ability bay grid ergonomics.

impact_assessment.why: Orbital stations currently render as basic line rings without docking infrastructure; ability cards suffer from flex wrap jitter on long descriptions; and tactical maneuvers lack pneumatic docking, warp thrum, and flak audio feedback.
impact_assessment.benefits: Elevates orbital station model fidelity with photovoltaic arrays and docking strobes; provides visceral audio feedback via Web Audio API synthesis; and delivers clean fixed-column ability card ergonomics.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preserve 60fps canvas performance and clean GameState serialization; dependency: zero external dependencies; concurrency: thread-safe engine; state: clean state cloning.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Offscreen sprite caching, deterministic procedural geometry, 12px font floor compliance, single-declaration palette compliance, and 100% test pass gate.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Verify: station photovoltaic arrays, synthesized sound (playDock, playWarp, playFlak), ability bay fixed 3-column grid and .ready cues; 1,111+ tests pass, Playwright browser audit 0 errors/0 hscroll/0 tiny; gates 5/5. checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-station-engineering-audio-and-ability-bay' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: harden typography floor across factions, relics, outposts, and combat canvas to eliminate sub-12px elements; add combat kinetic effects.

impact_assessment.why: Factions tab and other decks had legacy 10px and 11px font styles violating the >=12px readability floor; combat canvas had 8px/10px pips.
impact_assessment.benefits: 100% compliance with >=12px readability floor across all 15 cockpit tabs; crisp combat target telemetry.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no layout wrapping regressions; dependency: 0 external deps; concurrency: safe; state: safe.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Playwright full-tab audit across all viewports; 100% test pass gate.

checkpoints.description: [3/3] Verify: hardened typography floor across factions, relics, outposts, auto-trade, and combat canvas to eliminate sub-12px elements; 1,111+ tests pass, Playwright browser audit 0 errors/0 hscroll/0 tiny across all 15 tabs and click-map; gates 5/5. checklists: passed
Task 'voidfarer-typography-floor-and-combat-telemetry' completed successfully.
[1/3] Plan: align radar canvas hit-testing auScale with orbitFitScale in handleCanvasClick and handleCanvasMouseMove, and enable star body selection.

impact_assessment.why: handleCanvasClick and handleCanvasMouseMove used hardcoded 45*zoom*radarScale rather than orbitFitScale, causing clicked planets to be missed and open-space vectors to land at mismatched distances.
impact_assessment.benefits: Precise 1:1 click targeting for all celestial bodies, traffic, and vectors; clicking exactly selects the target under the cursor.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: preserve click behavior and point navigation; dependency: zero external deps; concurrency: safe; state: safe.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Playwright click testing; 100% test pass gate.
